summary: Converts CHOP samples to binary states and combines channels/inputs with logical operations such as invert, toggle, radio, and/or/xor.
key_concepts: Converts input CHOP samples to binary off/on states before applying later logic stages.
Convert Input chooses how continuous values become 0 or 1, including nonzero, positive, bounds, value-change, and name-change modes.
Channel Pre OP applies unary operations such as invert, toggle, radio button, rising edge, and falling edge.
Combine Channels can reduce many channels within each input to one logical result.
Combine CHOPs can combine corresponding channels across multiple input CHOPs by number or name.
Match and Align control multi-input channel pairing and interval alignment.

key_params.name: convert
key_params.note: Convert samples to binary by nonzero, positive, bounds, value change, or name change

key_params.name: chanop
key_params.note: Operation to combine channels within an input

key_params.name: chopop
key_params.note: Operation to combine multiple input CHOPs

key_params.name: match
key_params.note: Match channels between inputs by number or name

key_params.name: bound
key_params.note: Bounds used by Off When Outside Bounds

common_gotchas: Official docs note Logic CHOP is superseded for many event-style uses by CHOP Execute DAT or Text DAT scripts.
Convert Input changes continuous values into 0/1 before later operations; threshold choices matter more than downstream logic.
Value-change and name-change conversions are stateful and depend on previous samples/cooks.
One-input mode can reduce many channels to one; multi-input mode can reduce many CHOPs to one.
Use Math CHOP for arithmetic combinations instead of logical operations.
Lowest and Highest Index On return channel indices or -1, not simple boolean values.
Set Match and Align intentionally for multi-input plans so channel names and intervals are paired as intended.
